title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 and Ultra 2 hands-on: nice improvements with a rugged feel and new AI-powered fitness features, but a blockier shape is not for everyone (Damien Wilde/9to5Google)
summary: Damien Wilde / 9to5Google: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 and Ultra 2 hands-on: nice improvements with a rugged feel and new AI-powered fitness features, but a blockier shape is not for everyone — There are a number of reasons why Samsung dominates Wear OS, and the Galaxy Watch 9 and Ultra 2 exemplify that once again this year - here's what you need to know.
